title: Loop 005 Observational Multimodal Redundancy Bridge O001

dataset.primary: NEMAR on002722 / OpenNeuro ds002722 calibration dataset

stimulus_metadata: music/stimulus ID from duplicate event row

epistemic_scope: Observational association / incremental held-out information only.
No necessity, sufficiency, causal direction, phenomenal identity, or consciousness detection claim.
VA1/VA2 are first-person report channels and can include report/motor dynamics.

eeg.model_preprocess: training-fold median imputation -> standardization -> PCA 20 components

autonomic.ecg: 5-25 Hz Butterworth bandpass; select positive/negative peak orientation giving plausible 40-180 bpm rhythm; features mean HR, median HR, SDNN, RMSSD; mark invalid if <5 valid RR intervals
autonomic.gsr: standard deviation, range, linear slope, end-minus-start, second-half-minus-first-half

fixed_features.prior_report: mean same-axis VA report over seconds 10-14
categorical_stimulus_controls: music/stimulus ID >9 extracted from event pair

models.stimulus_only: one-hot target category + music ID -> Ridge
models.stimulus_prior: stimulus controls + prior same-axis report -> Ridge
models.eeg: stimulus controls + prior report + EEG PCA -> Ridge
models.autonomic: stimulus controls + prior report + ECG/GSR -> Ridge
models.combined: stimulus controls + prior report + EEG PCA + ECG/GSR -> Ridge

training.fitting_firewall: All imputation, scaling, PCA, one-hot fitting and alpha selection occur inside training folds only.

uncertainty: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples of outer held-out subjects for MAE differences

outcome_taxonomy.BIDIRECTIONAL_COMPLEMENTARITY: All three delta 95% bootstrap CIs are strictly >0 and QC gate passes.
outcome_taxonomy.AUTONOMIC_ADDS_ONLY: combined beats stimulus_prior and EEG-only, but does not beat autonomic-only.
outcome_taxonomy.EEG_ADDS_ONLY: combined beats stimulus_prior and autonomic-only, but does not beat EEG-only.
outcome_taxonomy.MULTIMODAL_INCREMENT_NO_CLEAR_COMPLEMENT: combined beats stimulus_prior but does not satisfy a one-way or bidirectional pattern cleanly.
outcome_taxonomy.NO_INCREMENT_BEYOND_PRIOR_REPORT_AND_STI: combined-vs-stimulus_prior CI includes or falls below 0.

negative_controls_and_sensitivities: Report stimulus-only baseline so physiology cannot win merely by stimulus identity.
Prior-report baseline is mandatory; physiology must add beyond affective inertia/self-report history.
Never use VA1, VA2, or VAtarg signal samples as physiology predictors.
Event target/music IDs may be used only as explicit baseline/control variables.
If ECG QC fails but GSR remains available, report autonomic analysis as LOW_ECG_QC rather than silently redefining autonomic signal.
Calibration dataset is primary. on002724 is only a later-session/same-subject replication subset, not independent external replication.
kill_condition: If combined physiology does not improve held-out future felt-report prediction beyond stimulus+prior-report baseline, this observational bridge supplies no evidence for unique multimodal state information at the chosen resolution. Do not change windows/features post hoc to rescue it.
